title: COOKED GRENADE WARNING STAYS OVER YOUR HEAD
why: His 10-31 report: a red feed line "cooked grenade! throw grenade now x6" showed when he held no grenade. The last-second warning is no longer a feed line at all; it flashes only over his own pillager while he holds the cooked frag. Watch: the cooked grenade warning stays over your head only.
now: The cooked grenade warning no longer shows in the message feed. It still flashes over your own head while you hold a cooked frag.
